title: S29b pile-up saturation energy recovery study

evaluation_design.split: train and held-out sets are disjoint by source run
evaluation_design.negative_control: clean single-pulse controls with matched source-run distribution

winner.name: template_residual_boosted_stack_new
winner.criterion: minimum held-out composite saturation-energy/timing score with run-block and injection-source bootstrap CIs reported

caveats: Truth comes from controlled injections into raw-ROOT-derived clean pulses.
Saturation is represented by an amplitude-ceiling proxy rather than electronics saturation flags.
Injection-source cells are retained provenance units, not exact residual waveform indices.
Pedestal robustness is inferred from run-local residual injection and low-amplitude sidebands.
PID boundary shifts are approximated by stave-conditioned energy closure; no final PID label is stored in the waveform tree.

required_endpoint_coverage.pile_up_separation: endpoint_metrics_ci.csv rows for detection AP, miss rate, false split rate
required_endpoint_coverage.saturation_recovery: endpoint_metrics_ci.csv fractional energy sigma68 and saturated-proxy strata
required_endpoint_coverage.pedestal_robustness: pedestal_saturation_strata.csv clean-amplitude sideband with run-local residuals
required_endpoint_coverage.energy_closure: endpoint_metrics_ci.csv energy bias plus event-level closure residuals
required_endpoint_coverage.pulse_shape_residuals: late-tail timing rate and event-level absolute timing residuals
